a5f7f729-ba54-5c83-8575-084087f9c700.description:
### Gaea's Grasp, 5 charges

- A wristlet of fine, woven vines. When the wearer grasps someone or something, the vines sprout tough tendrils that secure their grip. They will only release if lit ablaze or at the wearer's will.
- **Recharge**: Plant the withered wristlet in rich forest soil and water liberally with the blood of a fae. It will bloom into a new wristlet overnight.

- A large brown bottle full of dark, bitter beer. The label sports a block print of a crow with its beak wide, jagged noise-lines jutting out of its mouth. 1ebb5818-fbbf-5cb7-8d2f-6a7dd8bef5a0.description:
### Rune of Thud

- A heavy, palm-sized plate of shale with a strange symbol scratched deeply into the face. When pressed to a mundane or magical lock, roll a d6. On a 1-5, the lock unlocks silently. On a 6, the shale cracks with a thud that echoes for miles, leaving the bearer's hand temporarily numb and weakened from the shock.
- **Recharge**: If the cracked Rune is placed in a locked receptacle, the next time an unsuspecting thief picks the lock they will find the rune whole and functional within.

36cbd798-f028-59ed-b3cd-65f77987c4eb.name: Vibramail, 1 use
36cbd798-f028-59ed-b3cd-65f77987c4eb.description:
### Vibramail, 1 use

- A full suit of armor made of long metal bars running horizontally (2 armor, _bulky_).
- Moving in the armor causes the bars to knock together and vibrate, creating pleasant, resonant, and decidedly un-stealthy musical tones. When the wearer is reduced to 0 STR, all of the bars activate, vibrating and ringing out. The wearer's death is delayed, their body is held together and energized by the vibration, allowing them to stay on their feet and function as if they had 18 STR. This lasts until the sustained tone of the mail builds to a deafening level and the bars shatter, about a minute or so. They then die normally.

42350684-94c2-5beb-b42d-22ab0fd118e0.description:
### Master Map, 2 charges

- A folded sheet of waterproof vellum, brown and well worn. When opened a map of the local region blooms on its surface in a wash of ink, showing major geographical features and all nearby settlements. At the cost of one charge, write in the name of a place that does not appear on the map but that is known to exist somewhere in the region. The label will move, settling on this place's actual location on the map. The label spontaneously appears on all other extant maps of the region.
- **Recharge**: Sleep with the map under your pillow. When you wake, the map will have consumed your memory of the location of a place important to you, one that is not widely known.

9f247ca0-5ae9-5e59-8df6-c73fdc7b496b.description:
### Sack of Schemes, 1 charge

- A rust-colored suede bag that hosts a mischievous spirit and its host body, a random animal no larger than a dog. The host body shrinks to the size of a walnut while it is inside the bag, growing back to its normal size when it is released. After release, the spirit can be commanded for an hour, after which it will act according to its own capricious will. The spirit can speak in a wry, singsong voice regardless of its host body. If harm comes to its host body while or after it's been possessed, the spirit will become hostile toward the bearer.
- **Recharge**: Return the spirit to the sack. Its host body is spit out unharmed, the spirit bored of its form. An appropriately-sized creature of a species the spirit has never possessed before must be captured in the sack before it can be released again.

- A rectangular lantern with frosted, brown-stained glass. It's sealed tightly, with angular symbols scratched into the joints. A small reservoir on top feeds fuel to the petty Fae sealed inside, who illuminates the lamp with a pure white light.
- The only fuel the Fae accepts is a good quantity of blood from whoever will be carrying the lantern (d4 STR damage for an hour of light). It gets irritated by attempts to trick it with other blood, and may attempt an escape if aggravated enough.

### Peregrine Pellets, 3 uses

- A snakeskin pouch with three large bird pellets inside. They smell of tobacco. When the pellet is torn in half and consumed by two people, they learn a common, secret language that only the pair can understand.
- The aesthetics of the language are peculiar to that pair. It may be communicated through sound or gesture, but there is no written version. The language cannot be deciphered by anyone else through mundane or magical means, and it cannot be taught to anyone but the original pair.

### Birch Barque, 1 charge

- A folded sheet of pure white tree bark. When refolded into a toy dinghy and placed in a body of water it grows into a sturdy 8-footer with a remarkable resistance to capsizing, even in the roughest of waters. When you finish your journey, the bark will unfold back to its normal size, now soaked through and useless.
- **Recharge**: Catch a fish under the full moon from a sacred pool or river. Wrap it in the bark and cook it, then give the fish back to the water. The bark will float back to the surface, pure white and whole once more.

### Frostberry Sprig, 4 charges

- A small branch from a dark-leaved bush, laden with 4 ice-blue berries. The core of the branch is still green and lively. Plucking a berry and crushing it releases a blast of chill that leaves your fingers frostbitten. It might be useful to extinguish a fire, obscure someone's vision with rime, or momentarily freeze a limb in place.
- **Recharge**: Plant the end of the branch in the carcass of a freshly-killed hare, then let it sprout outdoors over three nights, undisturbed in the bitter cold. On the third morning, you will find the hare whole and healthy, nibbling at the leaves, and d6 fresh frostberries.

652dcef8-16bc-5f3a-adaf-23a188482ed8.description:
### Crooked Canteen, 3 charges

- A large flask, made of polished, deeply furrowed wood. The cap is attached by a silver ring, held closed with a pin. At the cost of one charge, twist the pin;  whatever fluid is inside is replaced with half a canteen-full of water. Twist it back, and the original fluid reappears. Handy for carrying extra water on journeys, hiding your best brandy from your fellow adventurers, or to convince a rival that there really isn't any poison in there, after all.
- **Recharge**: Dowse and dig out a fresh well or untouched spring, or any source of water that has never before passed mortal lips. Fill the Canteen to the brim.

e113e1ea-d3d5-52d6-a7d1-fc9955df2d23.description:
### Bidding Bones, 3 charges

- A pair of graying deer ribs cut to size for rhythmic performance. One has a crude skull etched into its surface, the other a skeletal hand. When played, they can be used to control the bones of another creature. If they still live, the effect is brief, a single instant of abrupt bodily control that may only be enough to foil another physical action. If they are dead or undead, the effect lasts for as long as the bearer can continue playing.
- **Recharge**: Stand at the edge of the dark wood, and throw one of the Bones overhand as far as you can into the tangle. Keep your eyes tightly shut as you enter to recover it. Do not peek, and do not respond to the taunting whispers of the dead that greet you.

### Grand Gob's Seal, 1 charge

- A wax stamp made of rocks, sticks, a bird skull and a rat tail. A paper stamped with this seal in greenish-yellow wax will be considered by any goblin as an order from the Grand Gob themself.
- At the cost of a charge, stamp a schematic describing a wondrous contraption or magical item, and gather a pile of shiny stones, straw, bugs, fungi, or the like into a pile vaguely shaped like said item. The pile binds together, and functions as the item described for about an hour. It then fails catastrophically.
- **Recharge**: Supplicate before the Grand Gob, describing in flowery terms how inferior you and your fellows are to their magnificence. Beg a boon of them - if impressed, they will provide a small, probably slimy token to tack onto the seal.

- Large round mirror about the size of a wagon wheel. Framed in a swirling art-nouveau confection of green-glazed clay.
- If you position yourself between Mirror Mirror and a mundane mirror and observe your infinite reflection between them, Mirror Mirror remembers the mundane mirror.

04d1598a-4577-5970-8368-b84a95a17dad.description:
### Wand of Smoke, 4 charges

- A wand roughly carved from charred wood that is hard as stone. 
- Spend 1 Charge to create a 30 ft. diameter thick cloud of smoke centered on you. It lasts for 1 Turn or until the wand leaves the area. 
- The wielder of the wand is not affected by the smoke and can see normally while inside the cloud.
- **Recharge:** Wrap the wand in parchment paper and burn it into a fire hot enough to melt iron.

b699a731-5733-52ec-9adc-85d87054706e.description:

- A golden ring meticulously engraved with lightning motifs.
- Spend 1 Charge to summon a thunderstorm in a 1 mile area centered on you. It works even if underground or inside buildings.
- **Recharge:** Get hit by lightning while wearing the ring.

7ae8303c-5430-5146-adfa-10586267ed79.name: Gaze of Two Minds (d6), 2 charges
7ae8303c-5430-5146-adfa-10586267ed79.description:
### Gaze of Two Minds (d6), 2 charges

- A blackened double-bladed dagger with a tiny jewelled handle.
- Cut yourself with the blade and spend 1 charge to summon an exact copy of yourself, with all your carried equipment. It disappears at the next dawn or dusk, whichever comes first.
- The copy will follow all your commands. It has all your knowledge and capabilities, and acts mostly like you, only being more reckless and cold. 
- **Recharge:** Feed a hungry beast with the fresh body of an innocent, and them kill the beast with the blade.

e3c9b519-7b0d-5ea2-83b7-0a6aab7f26f3.description:
### Ring of the Usurper

- A sturdy golden ring, its surface engraved with intertwined circles.
- Once donned, the ring can only be removed by the death of the wielder.
- The wielder no longer ages, and is able to kill any immortal being if they're able to deliver a mortal wound to such being. 
- Any immortal beings in the same world can feel when the ring is donned, by whom, and it's capabilities.

e193e620-ed4f-54c5-970e-93afb6b13b5c.name: Adaptive Skin
e193e620-ed4f-54c5-970e-93afb6b13b5c.description: Target can exist comfortably in hot or cold environments.

3c6abbdf-f7d2-5c5d-a757-ae1a5cebbacb.name: Addle Brain
3c6abbdf-f7d2-5c5d-a757-ae1a5cebbacb.description: Target must pass WIL save or drop to 0 WIL for 1 hour.

97071b21-a60e-5c49-a21b-9edfeb1a4235.name: Animal Call
97071b21-a60e-5c49-a21b-9edfeb1a4235.description: Summons a mundane beast. It holds no loyalty towards you or your allies.

6c71ae3f-f399-5aa8-b083-fec58303135d.name: Anti-Magic Globe
6c71ae3f-f399-5aa8-b083-fec58303135d.description: A thin shell of magical protection surrounds a small area around the caster. For every additional minute the globe is active they take one additional Fatigue.

daecb46c-e5ea-5844-a817-1f9ffa037682.name: Arachnid's Finesse
daecb46c-e5ea-5844-a817-1f9ffa037682.description: Target can walk on walls and ceilings.

0ff18603-ea16-56d3-8ac2-dbe07ddec517.name: Arcane Arrow
0ff18603-ea16-56d3-8ac2-dbe07ddec517.description: Green energy bursts from your fingers, dealing 1d6 damage and ignoring mundane armor.

b05ec3b5-c982-5a31-a9e5-2d3194eba669.name: Arcane Confinement
b05ec3b5-c982-5a31-a9e5-2d3194eba669.description: Target is bound by magical rope, able only to speak but nothing more.

fff72ad6-b225-5b50-9cf7-73b781c1deb2.name: Arcane Epistle
fff72ad6-b225-5b50-9cf7-73b781c1deb2.description: You write a letter that only its intended reader can understand.

aae6da4a-eb00-5b95-a51d-6ba78cbf2822.name: Arcane Fireworks
aae6da4a-eb00-5b95-a51d-6ba78cbf2822.description: Target flame becomes a great conflagration of heat, light and sound.

e3792284-440d-5589-b21b-311d2865f5b9.name: Arcane Stain
e3792284-440d-5589-b21b-311d2865f5b9.description: Inscribes an invisible rune you can feel. Suffer 1d4 WIL loss if removed.

27d12f02-053f-52cd-9bc4-22996872dd02.name: Architect's Eye
27d12f02-053f-52cd-9bc4-22996872dd02.description: Any hidden doors within 60ft light up as if on fire.

1cf6aad5-5cf4-5604-985c-7d88beb1c158.name: Architect's Perfection
1cf6aad5-5cf4-5604-985c-7d88beb1c158.description: Create a holographic wall, floor, or ceiling that looks absolutely real.

8e8dcc7f-34d9-5586-8fa8-18912f40b67c.name: Astral Step
8e8dcc7f-34d9-5586-8fa8-18912f40b67c.description: You and anyone touching you instantly transport to a known location you have been to before.

78e8daab-c975-5662-aacd-8e029b99bfcf.name: Banishment
78e8daab-c975-5662-aacd-8e029b99bfcf.description: WIL save or creature to returns to native plane.

a021fc94-9a12-5473-8d76-528e6a4464bc.name: Become Unseen
a021fc94-9a12-5473-8d76-528e6a4464bc.description: Target becomes invisible for 1 hour, and are still able use abilities and attack without detection. Afterwards they become incapacitated (deprived)

a94bd6c2-d64f-54a4-a4b2-a57e1192122e.name: Beguilement
a94bd6c2-d64f-54a4-a4b2-a57e1192122e.description: Target humanoid must make a WIL save or is controlled telepathically.

66ac302e-ee2b-5a34-923e-7d948a6de872.name: Bewildering Fog
66ac302e-ee2b-5a34-923e-7d948a6de872.description: A hazy fog surrounds you in a radius of 20ft. Attacks within the mist are impaired.

751d7c1d-4178-5fd6-a639-2777bbe4098b.name: Blazing Defense
751d7c1d-4178-5fd6-a639-2777bbe4098b.description: You manifest a shield of flame (+1 Armor, 1d6 damage). Fire cannot hurt you.

4018f54e-c8f5-596f-bccd-26ac35e57455.name: Blessing
4018f54e-c8f5-596f-bccd-26ac35e57455.description: Target’s attacks are enhanced and non-Blast attacks are impaired against them until they next take damage.

76d1bc83-0713-5192-8571-8043339fd197.name: Bolster
76d1bc83-0713-5192-8571-8043339fd197.description: A person you can see is emboldened by your words for a few minutes: their attacks are enhanced and they cannot become deprived.

41d56719-f584-56e3-8157-173ee2984877.name: Bound
41d56719-f584-56e3-8157-173ee2984877.description: Target can make a single jump to any place they can see.

4a252cdd-3ee3-53ba-b08c-6befe2184d3b.name: Boundless Message
4a252cdd-3ee3-53ba-b08c-6befe2184d3b.description: Delivers a single sentence to any one creature instantaneously, no matter the distance.

ff899d18-9f6c-5a69-9811-031d5d37ce4b.name: Burning Missile
ff899d18-9f6c-5a69-9811-031d5d37ce4b.description: You fire an acid missile that does 1d6 damage to a target for every round it is not washed off.

1d0d1edf-9ee1-5cd5-9012-191d01995356.name: Burnishing Bubble
1d0d1edf-9ee1-5cd5-9012-191d01995356.description: Target is enclosed by an impenetrable sphere that rolls along the ground, unless they pass a DEX save.

48031407-31ff-5f3d-aeef-ef550b2868c0.name: Calcify
48031407-31ff-5f3d-aeef-ef550b2868c0.description: Target object turns to stone at the caster's touch. Living targets save vs STR.

adaba013-3296-5b0f-8041-34c950da091a.name: Catsense
adaba013-3296-5b0f-8041-34c950da091a.description: Target has heightened senses for the next hour, especially at night.

cd688051-fa4e-5afd-8294-62df0c00aea7.name: Chilling Graze
cd688051-fa4e-5afd-8294-62df0c00aea7.description: Target loses 1d4+1 STR and is deprived.

3ee271be-0182-5c28-8c82-da3a5dd96160.name: Cinder Flesh
3ee271be-0182-5c28-8c82-da3a5dd96160.description: Energy beams burn enemies (1d10 blast damage) in a straight line.

b169f54e-49e7-51a1-ac63-7844646be435.name: Circle of Arcane Protection
b169f54e-49e7-51a1-ac63-7844646be435.description: Magical or godly beings cannot enter a 10ft circle.

2f6b6cf8-b9f4-5f66-979c-6a23ec41fdad.name: Cleanse
2f6b6cf8-b9f4-5f66-979c-6a23ec41fdad.description: Rotten or poisoned food becomes edible.

cd57265c-9444-5d3e-a3a4-d2d2cd4ad74e.name: Cold Spray
cd57265c-9444-5d3e-a3a4-d2d2cd4ad74e.description: A spray of cold air does d6 damage 20ft in one direction.

25470465-6637-5bc4-8984-c64a5372e89b.name: Conceal Object
25470465-6637-5bc4-8984-c64a5372e89b.description: Masks an object against divination or scrying.

0655dee1-8fe3-5cf1-a1ab-1206e89ed36d.name: Conquer Gravity
0655dee1-8fe3-5cf1-a1ab-1206e89ed36d.description: Target moves up or down according to your whims.

2d69e010-a495-5015-b48c-367e9c3a6314.name: Cosmic Fingertips
2d69e010-a495-5015-b48c-367e9c3a6314.description: Your hands sculpt stone, rock or minerals into any form you please.

168006fd-33da-5659-8457-00ff7bd54837.name: Coup de Grâce
168006fd-33da-5659-8457-00ff7bd54837.description: An ally's next attack ignores armor and takes damage directly from their target's STR.

675dd6f9-0298-5075-9861-ba4e46ba2b53.name: Craft from Clay
675dd6f9-0298-5075-9861-ba4e46ba2b53.description: Any natural, earthen target is transformed (rock to mud, lava to rock, etc).

bff8232e-6d9a-59bc-bb43-4fd6ec995862.name: Create Unlife
bff8232e-6d9a-59bc-bb43-4fd6ec995862.description: Creates 1d4 undead skeletons and zombies from corpses. WIL save every hour to control them.

93b5fd40-a186-5055-b147-0014ceecac7a.name: Curse of the Sightless
93b5fd40-a186-5055-b147-0014ceecac7a.description: Anyone within eyesight must make a WIL save or be blinded.

46b500ce-bfaf-53bc-9723-8fe285659181.name: Curse Unlife
46b500ce-bfaf-53bc-9723-8fe285659181.description: Deals 1d4+2 STR loss to one undead, ignoring armor and resistances.

18ee4159-da08-5a60-81cd-b61000e9b4f3.name: Cure-All
18ee4159-da08-5a60-81cd-b61000e9b4f3.description: A single illness or disease dissipates at your touch.

9581642c-a60e-559d-912e-6b56caa47d15.name: Cute Ink
9581642c-a60e-559d-912e-6b56caa47d15.description: A single page in a book can be altered to hide its true content.

73d8e03c-a49a-504f-8d59-c311374658b9.name: Darksight
73d8e03c-a49a-504f-8d59-c311374658b9.description: Target can see 60 ft. in total darkness.

9cc9adc5-0467-5ee1-8523-8b810bb378c6.name: Death's Breath
9cc9adc5-0467-5ee1-8523-8b810bb378c6.description: You summon a poisonous cloud (d6 STR loss) you can control.

aa405bca-7212-5e40-99f3-414779cb2852.name: Devil's Comedian
aa405bca-7212-5e40-99f3-414779cb2852.description: WIL save or target laughs uncontrollably, unable to take any action.

9f6943ce-deb1-595c-9867-9922a34009ce.name: Disaster Fluid
9f6943ce-deb1-595c-9867-9922a34009ce.description: Anything in a 10ft square becomes slippery; DEX save to avoid slipping.

6d4a40d5-eaaa-5545-b1ef-0288cc687b24.name: Disrupt Scry
6d4a40d5-eaaa-5545-b1ef-0288cc687b24.description: Future divinations of one creature or object are misled according to your will.

5db63143-f2fc-5047-9c33-7b1a8e33bccd.name: Doppleganger
5db63143-f2fc-5047-9c33-7b1a8e33bccd.description: You spawn 1d6 decoy duplicates of someone you touch. Decoys are dispelled with a touch.

f88d8f9f-c00e-5114-83c1-e86b78945d9f.name: Dreampoison
f88d8f9f-c00e-5114-83c1-e86b78945d9f.description: Target is deprived after suffering a night of bad dreams.

f0e12780-ae67-5783-bcb0-edb8a5dbd448.name: Dreamtalker
f0e12780-ae67-5783-bcb0-edb8a5dbd448.description: Sends a message to anyone currently asleep.

48f27019-eb08-5273-9591-bb38cf87c7d3.name: Easy Descent
48f27019-eb08-5273-9591-bb38cf87c7d3.description: Objects or creatures nearby fall very slowly.

52810b5f-de0e-5a2b-9f3f-4c47f85e2d01.name: Edifice
52810b5f-de0e-5a2b-9f3f-4c47f85e2d01.description: You summon a stone wall up to 20ft wide that you can control.

facd3883-0dd6-5584-831f-7d0bb9e9b952.name: Energize Rope
facd3883-0dd6-5584-831f-7d0bb9e9b952.description: A rope-like objects moves at your command.

5d1a28b2-e9b1-5e11-bb38-2254492c26ee.name: Ensorcelled
5d1a28b2-e9b1-5e11-bb38-2254492c26ee.description: Creatures are enraptured for a few minutes unless they pass a WIL save.

a005fa4a-8919-59e7-9707-0b10253b715d.name: Envision
a005fa4a-8919-59e7-9707-0b10253b715d.description: Spies on a target you have met, even across vast distances. On a WIL save, they can feel your presence.

ac3fc9f8-1c30-52f5-afe6-41f7884cacb9.name: Ephemeral Audio
ac3fc9f8-1c30-52f5-afe6-41f7884cacb9.description: Point to a spot. Anyone nearby hears a sound you choose at any volume.

7b03ecab-b05f-5957-b6f3-ecf47258bc0a.name: Epidemic
7b03ecab-b05f-5957-b6f3-ecf47258bc0a.description: Infects target with disease, which spreads until the source of magic is destroyed.

2b3d2a16-de42-588e-89f9-62d6f09d10cf.name: Extraplanar Convocation
2b3d2a16-de42-588e-89f9-62d6f09d10cf.description: Summons any extraplanar being onto your plane. It holds no loyalty towards you or your allies.

bd08cb7f-f469-5fd6-8479-f9e138c3773d.name: Extraplanar Request
bd08cb7f-f469-5fd6-8479-f9e138c3773d.description: Ask a single question of a random extraplanar entity.

31ae37be-310f-54e4-8325-e336e80e4651.name: Feline Dexterity
31ae37be-310f-54e4-8325-e336e80e4651.description: Target becomes limber, lithe and as fast as quicksilver.

edbb82a5-d1d1-58e7-bfa0-6be9691ea65b.name: Find Virulence
edbb82a5-d1d1-58e7-bfa0-6be9691ea65b.description: Detects poison in any creature or object within 30ft.

998c3f70-2953-5a6d-b789-92006648e566.name: Fire Curse
998c3f70-2953-5a6d-b789-92006648e566.description: An object you touch is imbued with a hidden flame-trap dealing 1d4+2 STR loss.

b6ac42a8-7004-51b7-88ae-11edbaae984b.name: Firey Missile
b6ac42a8-7004-51b7-88ae-11edbaae984b.description: A bow you touch can fire flaming arrows (1d10 damage) for one minute.

67f4131b-7a74-50ed-9e16-9d5dfd76e6be.name: Fish Lung
67f4131b-7a74-50ed-9e16-9d5dfd76e6be.description: A target can breathe underwater until they surface again.

9e91b351-d77f-52bf-bac7-081f63e35a6d.name: Fleetfooted
9e91b351-d77f-52bf-bac7-081f63e35a6d.description: One creature moves at double speed.

e5eb1391-5cb3-5a95-bd0b-88f86203ec71.name: Flicker
e5eb1391-5cb3-5a95-bd0b-88f86203ec71.description: Target randomly vanishes and reappears once at will.

6861de36-e7ee-5af1-87de-78c84a217b00.name: Fog of Nausea
6861de36-e7ee-5af1-87de-78c84a217b00.description: A cloud of nauseating vapors pours out from the Spellbook's pages. Anyone nearby makes a STR save or vomit uncontrollably.

8f59dbc3-6773-5f07-897b-1133523e9840.name: Fold Portal
8f59dbc3-6773-5f07-897b-1133523e9840.description: A door you touch opens into another door you've stepped through before until it is shut again.

64b3038c-453e-50c7-9cee-a6d96fb4f3ae.name: Foolishness
64b3038c-453e-50c7-9cee-a6d96fb4f3ae.description: A target you touch becomes vulnerable to wild mood swings, sweeping conclusions and silly behavior. They also lose 1d6 WIL for 24 hours (down to a minimum of 1).

0edbbe10-c353-51f4-8784-f629ed050988.name: Fortify
0edbbe10-c353-51f4-8784-f629ed050988.description: Damage from heat, ice, acid or electricity are impaired against a target for the next hour.

ac3974b4-c0b0-523b-ab31-0b014a6a72c0.name: Frozen Corpse
ac3974b4-c0b0-523b-ab31-0b014a6a72c0.description: A corpse you touch is preserved.

91baf033-1f2e-56a4-8ca7-0dfe0c70d895.name: Gale
91baf033-1f2e-56a4-8ca7-0dfe0c70d895.description: You summon an impenetrable wall of energy up to 15ft wide.

fd2e0f15-2374-574d-8bb5-374a55e5f6b0.name: Ghost Whisper
fd2e0f15-2374-574d-8bb5-374a55e5f6b0.description: You and a sympathetic ally are linked, able to converse in short sentences for an hour.

ea65df44-02d2-5bd1-8c97-a716048c7938.name: Gift of Flight
ea65df44-02d2-5bd1-8c97-a716048c7938.description: Target can fly for a short while.

5da64304-d574-5d55-a410-4db9edca5124.name: Glacier
5da64304-d574-5d55-a410-4db9edca5124.description: You create a wall of ice (15 HP, 3 Armor) around a creature you choose.

9063e159-6669-55f5-a7e2-e422fecbe513.name: Gorgon's Gaze
9063e159-6669-55f5-a7e2-e422fecbe513.description: Target is transformed into a statue on a failed WIL save. A success reverses the spell; holder must pass a WIL save or the book is destroyed.

5d6f92c3-3f09-57a0-873a-8d89ff8548c6.name: Great Ball of Fire
5d6f92c3-3f09-57a0-873a-8d89ff8548c6.description: You fire a ball of flame (1d10 damage) up to 20 feet away.

c2de65be-5f08-5b71-a04a-e195d54e840d.name: Hand of the Protector
c2de65be-5f08-5b71-a04a-e195d54e840d.description: A giant, floating hand blocks all damage from a single opponent until you are safe from danger.

ee4b8b84-c869-534d-9206-a502c64362c5.name: Healing Grace
ee4b8b84-c869-534d-9206-a502c64362c5.description: A target heals 1d6 STR, and you become deprived until you take the time to mediate, pray or sleep.

fbe9554b-e64a-527d-8338-9c32fb64b2f4.name: Heatless Torch
fbe9554b-e64a-527d-8338-9c32fb64b2f4.description: Turns any object into a permanent, heatless torch.

9ec48933-1440-5899-a808-a9b616e62186.name: Hedgemagick
9ec48933-1440-5899-a808-a9b616e62186.description: You perform a minor magical trick (create flame, wind, light or sound).

70871bd3-85c3-5dc8-b397-7bf65a826851.name: Hempen Hoop
70871bd3-85c3-5dc8-b397-7bf65a826851.description: A rope moves at your command.

9042622c-1bcd-5aa7-abb4-aeb280d80c61.name: Hide Mind
9042622c-1bcd-5aa7-abb4-aeb280d80c61.description: The next person to scry your mind or your whereabouts is fooled.

b80f9a13-c268-5b42-8a1d-4561d21a08ea.name: Hoodwink Monster
b80f9a13-c268-5b42-8a1d-4561d21a08ea.description: Target monster makes a WIL save or treats you as an ally.

9d89d170-0b30-54f5-84f9-90a099fb0166.name: Hoodwink Person
9d89d170-0b30-54f5-84f9-90a099fb0166.description: Target becomes a friend until out of sight.

fa77979a-7f65-5540-b376-6f3f1209c2fc.name: Hovering Protection
fa77979a-7f65-5540-b376-6f3f1209c2fc.description: A hovering, transparent disk materializes around an ally granting 1 Armor.

06fd4ea8-3f05-5f47-8768-f076eb14f72f.name: Ice Ray
06fd4ea8-3f05-5f47-8768-f076eb14f72f.description: Ice and snow flow from your fingerprints, dealing 1d8 damage (blast) in a straight line.

f18d06f8-898b-5fa3-8e98-4fe8195382d7.name: Icy Tempest
f18d06f8-898b-5fa3-8e98-4fe8195382d7.description: Hail deals 1d12 damage in a 20ft radius.

07302102-5cc2-5230-bd38-91ebbd9a02a8.name: Ill Fate
07302102-5cc2-5230-bd38-91ebbd9a02a8.description: Target automatically fails next their next save.

a7af008f-726f-5910-b547-acbf2ffe1a7f.name: Illusory Landscape
a7af008f-726f-5910-b547-acbf2ffe1a7f.description: You can make one type of terrain appear like another.

aa17b6b7-88a1-543f-a6f0-6e42d54910e8.name: Induce Despair
aa17b6b7-88a1-543f-a6f0-6e42d54910e8.description: Target must pass a WIL save or its attacks are impaired.

43ab484a-b767-5c28-88f7-99c6f90be1c9.name: Induce Horror
43ab484a-b767-5c28-88f7-99c6f90be1c9.description: Target makes a WIL save or flees.

0a1631b2-4c77-55a5-8c2f-5a78b3e627d0.name: Inferno
0a1631b2-4c77-55a5-8c2f-5a78b3e627d0.description: You summon a flaming wall up to 15ft wide. Anyone passing through suffers 1d6 STR loss.

39961809-81e0-57e0-8030-ecc5120d5c8a.name: Influence
39961809-81e0-57e0-8030-ecc5120d5c8a.description: Target gains armor 3 but running and swimming are impossible.

2791ab6d-4a01-5e9a-b119-b0f401f86394.name: Insubstantiate
2791ab6d-4a01-5e9a-b119-b0f401f86394.description: Target becomes insubstantial and can float.

ff7f6d24-05e8-5558-979f-6905198fce96.name: Kraken's Curse
ff7f6d24-05e8-5558-979f-6905198fce96.description: Tentacles grapple all within 20 ft, STR save to break free.

6adf1b9a-2291-5b6f-bcf1-fb7295cdf3e6.name: Lamp's Hue
6adf1b9a-2291-5b6f-bcf1-fb7295cdf3e6.description: Target object shines like a torch for one hour.

cded95ce-ec33-590d-a501-3df2a761d20b.name: Latch
cded95ce-ec33-590d-a501-3df2a761d20b.description: An unlocked box, cabinet or door opens or closes at your command.

8de0eb55-34ed-5ea7-9112-5f07e2ed9558.name: Lichsense
8de0eb55-34ed-5ea7-9112-5f07e2ed9558.description: You feel any undead within 60ft. WIL save to avoid detection by intelligent undead.

2c6407d7-52a2-505c-bb69-3df80e520f8e.name: Light Show
2c6407d7-52a2-505c-bb69-3df80e520f8e.description: You control a dazzling display of light and color.

50c81950-75d3-5720-8877-0ec8124b21ca.name: Lightning Strike
50c81950-75d3-5720-8877-0ec8124b21ca.description: Electricity flings from your fingertips doing 1d12 damage (blast) in a line.

fa927010-85fe-5e0a-8bb2-dca821a5d33c.name: Linguist
fa927010-85fe-5e0a-8bb2-dca821a5d33c.description: For the next hour you can speak and understand any mundane language.

638348f1-43a9-5000-9f43-d2eb0c77cbb6.name: Magic Seal
638348f1-43a9-5000-9f43-d2eb0c77cbb6.description: Magically locks a door, portal or chest.

b4066abe-655a-5cd3-be24-8b3de7a9fecb.name: Major Genesis
b4066abe-655a-5cd3-be24-8b3de7a9fecb.description: Creates an object of nonliving stone or metal no greater than 5 cubic foot in size.

45a34a30-fa2e-51af-b231-3d9bee30868b.name: Maker
45a34a30-fa2e-51af-b231-3d9bee30868b.description: Transforms raw materials into finished items.

a2b06bab-5238-5b3b-934c-ec208c85ecfe.name: Manic Fury
a2b06bab-5238-5b3b-934c-ec208c85ecfe.description: A target's attacks are enhanced. They must make a WIL save after a successful killing or lose control, attacking anyone in sight.

5eb0f1f5-cdc7-5648-9ef8-ce3bdb014781.name: Masquerade
5eb0f1f5-cdc7-5648-9ef8-ce3bdb014781.description: You assume the likeness of a similar creature you have seen.

f4496a9e-093b-5e7b-81d3-dd6df2eee392.name: Master Undead
f4496a9e-093b-5e7b-81d3-dd6df2eee392.description: Undead creatures obey your command. Intelligent undead make a WIL save.

c6499127-f7f1-5e14-8bd7-f2369a79684d.name: Mental Tripwire
c6499127-f7f1-5e14-8bd7-f2369a79684d.description: Intruders set off an alarm audible only to you.

f1c96b97-6100-5292-898e-d50419dfde48.name: Mind Bond
f1c96b97-6100-5292-898e-d50419dfde48.description: Two allies can communicate via a mental link for the rest of the day.

ca00ff27-c554-57ec-88df-989e12a562e6.name: Mind Reader
ca00ff27-c554-57ec-88df-989e12a562e6.description: You can see or hear any person you have met before.

bab69cd1-ea4b-5b0b-a1ca-1f5bf114582f.name: Miniaturize
bab69cd1-ea4b-5b0b-a1ca-1f5bf114582f.description: An object shrinks to one tenth its size.

b28a446c-feff-5ded-b57f-65d557d1e044.name: Minor Aegis
b28a446c-feff-5ded-b57f-65d557d1e044.description: A target you touch ignores the next instance of harm from a specific source.

b9baf124-0050-5632-9c8a-5ae41e173201.name: Minor Genesis
b9baf124-0050-5632-9c8a-5ae41e173201.description: Creates an object of nonliving matter no greater than one cubic foot in size.

0c0be8c0-77d8-505c-887f-167bacc4754d.name: Mirage
0c0be8c0-77d8-505c-887f-167bacc4754d.description: You summon a noiseless & simple illusion of your choice.

25b7fc48-c430-5609-87dc-e47f4a3e89db.name: Molasses Veins
25b7fc48-c430-5609-87dc-e47f4a3e89db.description: A single target moves at half speed.

33422d06-fcb6-5bde-a46c-7fb4bd5acd5b.name: Murky Bubble
33422d06-fcb6-5bde-a46c-7fb4bd5acd5b.description: You create a bubble supernatural shadow within a 20ft radius.

d0827a21-900c-59dc-8903-61744d0ea8f9.name: Necrotic Touch
d0827a21-900c-59dc-8903-61744d0ea8f9.description: Target must DEX save or is paralyzed.

cdd6e465-ae00-51ca-a2dc-11033ff7bf02.name: Obfuscate
cdd6e465-ae00-51ca-a2dc-11033ff7bf02.description: Target cannot be observed either through divination or scrying.

f745cefb-b085-51b1-ae50-7485ce114b54.name: Obscuring Mist
f745cefb-b085-51b1-ae50-7485ce114b54.description: A rolling fog obscures vision in a 300ft radius.

527a70af-8eca-5cad-9e20-bfdfb79b8668.name: Opaque Cover
527a70af-8eca-5cad-9e20-bfdfb79b8668.description: Details about your person become obscured and unmemorable.

296f3f3e-b0cf-5737-851b-1330ff00893e.name: Orb of Ignus
296f3f3e-b0cf-5737-851b-1330ff00893e.description: You control a floating ball of fire (1d8 damage) for a short while.

a5292e09-92ad-5dd9-8374-afea7be5bbdb.name: Orb of Immortality
a5292e09-92ad-5dd9-8374-afea7be5bbdb.description: Mundane attacks cannot harm anyone within a 10ft radius, or vice-versa.

dc636c09-33db-5206-8292-363db07d8336.name: Otherwordly Pet
dc636c09-33db-5206-8292-363db07d8336.description: Summons an unintelligent extraplanar creature up to the size of a small dog. It holds no loyalty towards you or your allies.

546f3c44-af5c-5915-9a92-f84461c28fcb.name: Otherworldly Gate
546f3c44-af5c-5915-9a92-f84461c28fcb.description: Opens a portal to another reality. It works in both directions.

237a1ca5-444a-550b-85b7-45f1ba7809c1.name: Paincurrent
237a1ca5-444a-550b-85b7-45f1ba7809c1.description: An arc of electricity passes from your fingertips to a target you touch. They take 1d8 damage (1d12 if wearing metal armor).

46b0b252-c9a9-55aa-8b62-2609a8eec6c5.name: Passage
46b0b252-c9a9-55aa-8b62-2609a8eec6c5.description: Creates a temporary path through wood, stone or brick.

ad235740-2580-552d-b2aa-a0da0f3f381f.name: Passive Invisibility
ad235740-2580-552d-b2aa-a0da0f3f381f.description: Target is invisible until they attempt harm.

b3c13491-b496-57e0-a0d9-fda4c257ec64.name: Peeping Warlock
b3c13491-b496-57e0-a0d9-fda4c257ec64.description: You control a pair of floating eyes so long as yours remain closed.

6104dd5a-a67a-5bf8-93a6-318136f96aec.name: Perfect Illusion
6104dd5a-a67a-5bf8-93a6-318136f96aec.description: Creates an image with sound, smell and thermal effects, activated according to a trigger you choose. Touching the image or making a successful WIL save will reveal the illusion.

b4c64099-6e0f-54f7-ba7a-91e87e2a6ffe.name: Perfect Preservation
b4c64099-6e0f-54f7-ba7a-91e87e2a6ffe.description: A weapon you touch becomes immune to wear, mundane damage or elemental effects. The spell wears off after a day.

ddac01f9-f952-5aa2-82e3-16fc4f65481e.name: Phantom Hound
ddac01f9-f952-5aa2-82e3-16fc4f65481e.description: A ghostly canine (4 HP, bite (1d4)) obeys your commands for up to one hour.

7b353989-1d98-573f-ad4a-5ff5069c4119.name: Phase Anchor
7b353989-1d98-573f-ad4a-5ff5069c4119.description: Binds an extraplanar creature to your will until it performs a task specific task, after which they must pass a WIL save to escape (good luck).

2783286f-390c-5aab-80a6-84ec00940281.name: Phase Sneak
2783286f-390c-5aab-80a6-84ec00940281.description: Anyone within a 10ft radius is rendered invisible.

d1643c33-81b7-5a23-953e-03db78013c19.name: Phase Touch
d1643c33-81b7-5a23-953e-03db78013c19.description: A disembodied, floating hand obeys your whims but is immaterial. The next Spellbook, ability or item that relies on touch now works from a distance.

f6ebe328-8f73-5e8b-a629-2d6d745485ce.name: Philolomancy
f6ebe328-8f73-5e8b-a629-2d6d745485ce.description: You understand all spoken and written languages.

37432b94-a6f3-58d0-a345-87ce1943962d.name: Philosopher's Mind
37432b94-a6f3-58d0-a345-87ce1943962d.description: Target is immune to spiritual or psychic attacks, as well as any attempts at mental or spiritual manipulation or persuasion.

fae1ed63-9c2f-5f1e-9428-ec5dc9715fdd.name: Plant Scourge
fae1ed63-9c2f-5f1e-9428-ec5dc9715fdd.description: Plants within eyesight wither and die.

eddd954b-596a-5122-9e6b-f0a260d504d2.name: Pocket Container
eddd954b-596a-5122-9e6b-f0a260d504d2.description: Summons a chest from an immaterial plane. It holds up to 6 items. The chest is dismissed at will.

8524e9b7-f82d-5bb8-b5ad-e93eaf0399f1.name: Pocket Sun
8524e9b7-f82d-5bb8-b5ad-e93eaf0399f1.description: You create a halo of bright light in a 60ft radius.

25373250-92ec-5c16-8033-1c45129e6e19.name: Prisma Shard
25373250-92ec-5c16-8033-1c45129e6e19.description: An array of hypnotic lights fascinate nearby creatures, unless they pass a WIL save.

14fb3f3f-8483-58a3-a73a-d34634402f2d.name: Profane Reveal
14fb3f3f-8483-58a3-a73a-d34634402f2d.description: Target an empty space to reveal invisible objects or creatures.

c4f52410-df0c-51ea-9088-3c164ddd1288.name: Psychic Eye
c4f52410-df0c-51ea-9088-3c164ddd1288.description: Invisible floating eye allowing you to observe a single location as present.

76f79050-48f0-5da9-8ac3-678a5ccb461b.name: Psychokinesis
76f79050-48f0-5da9-8ac3-678a5ccb461b.description: Magically moves an object up to half your weight.

dae7fcc4-a61d-5f4c-be4d-30c082ed3e7d.name: Puppeteer
dae7fcc4-a61d-5f4c-be4d-30c082ed3e7d.description: You can throw your voice a great distance away

9c36742b-b550-5952-9fb2-7f9156ae13bd.name: Purge Text
9c36742b-b550-5952-9fb2-7f9156ae13bd.description: Mundane or magical writing vanishes at your touch.

3d92c01a-bcfa-5282-a8b3-4be29ec34c68.name: Pyramid of Passivity
3d92c01a-bcfa-5282-a8b3-4be29ec34c68.description: Target creatures must make a DEX save or their attacks are impaired.

ab9b04eb-2a0a-5b09-a167-10a0a14e12bb.name: Pyschic Touch
ab9b04eb-2a0a-5b09-a167-10a0a14e12bb.description: You can hear target's surface thoughts, so long as you touch them.

a46c16dd-36a9-52dc-9b74-10cc5c9ba5bc.name: Rat-Tat-Tat
a46c16dd-36a9-52dc-9b74-10cc5c9ba5bc.description: Loudly opens a locked or magically sealed door or chest.

bf10f099-9dd3-5f16-9a9e-5be43aa406c9.name: Ravenless Message
bf10f099-9dd3-5f16-9a9e-5be43aa406c9.description: You send a short message 1 mile that anyone along its path can hear.

ae41db6b-3672-5854-aae7-2c37cb81a973.name: Reject Unlife
ae41db6b-3672-5854-aae7-2c37cb81a973.description: Nearby undead are immobilized for 30 seconds or until you take another action.

dc07c9b7-700d-5878-8a7e-0fa7e572c627.name: Remembered Voice
dc07c9b7-700d-5878-8a7e-0fa7e572c627.description: A spot you mark becomes the trigger for a supernatural recording of your voice, delivering a short message of your choice.

c83bb08f-0cb3-525f-a23b-1cfae1df87d5.name: Reverie
c83bb08f-0cb3-525f-a23b-1cfae1df87d5.description: Targets become dazed for a moment, as if lost in daydream.

1c212821-3d8c-53c4-9556-0c59b4d850c3.name: Runic Harm
1c212821-3d8c-53c4-9556-0c59b4d850c3.description: A rune you draw causes great pain to the reader, who must WIL save or scream until they pass out (1d4 WIL loss). A successful save destroys the rune.

7fdd0615-046d-5c06-888a-ff111a737d8d.name: Runic Slumber
7fdd0615-046d-5c06-888a-ff111a737d8d.description: A rune you draw puts the reader into a magical sleep that lasts 1d6 hours.

abc39a9d-c41f-5154-9341-2e4ce8c20775.name: Safe Haven
abc39a9d-c41f-5154-9341-2e4ce8c20775.description: You summon a floating, invisible refuge for 8 hours. It fits up to 8 people comfortably.

44f9b83e-e582-537d-8538-e39c0b2fe70f.name: Scintillate
44f9b83e-e582-537d-8538-e39c0b2fe70f.description: Target must WIL save or their attacks become impaired.

ce5ea8fc-30d7-5695-9e5d-2d781e9d173d.name: Scry Creature
ce5ea8fc-30d7-5695-9e5d-2d781e9d173d.description: Indicates the precise location of a familiar creature.

7c99de6b-00b5-5d47-9e7a-060c461465ae.name: Scry Object
7c99de6b-00b5-5d47-9e7a-060c461465ae.description: Indicates the precise location of an object, known or otherwise.

3ccb67b5-a675-555c-8a0f-7bf9c42cf655.name: Scrying Ward
3ccb67b5-a675-555c-8a0f-7bf9c42cf655.description: For 24 hours you become aware of any magical eavesdropping.

71df579d-decc-545e-b0bc-92606be2dc9e.name: Sculpt Water
71df579d-decc-545e-b0bc-92606be2dc9e.description: Raise, lower or part nearby water.

8b38a8d0-8e11-576e-881c-f36847d73ce3.name: Secret Attaché
8b38a8d0-8e11-576e-881c-f36847d73ce3.description: You summon an invisible creature of great power that obeys your every command. Reading from other Spellbooks dispels the creature.

a281cb23-2ca0-52d5-8eba-4a963527e7ca.name: Shelter
a281cb23-2ca0-52d5-8eba-4a963527e7ca.description: Creates a standing edifice that can shelter up to 10 creatures, disappearing after 24 hours.

dac39b9c-c931-5ca5-8a30-c78746e30c86.name: Shrinking Cant
dac39b9c-c931-5ca5-8a30-c78746e30c86.description: A humanoid creature you touch halves in size.

dafba8a3-2c56-55ba-98fe-3d4a01fc4504.name: Signal
dafba8a3-2c56-55ba-98fe-3d4a01fc4504.description: Sends up a flare that can be seen for some distance.

bd3fa1e0-1f0e-5e11-8be9-e1d883e760f2.name: Simple Illusion
bd3fa1e0-1f0e-5e11-8be9-e1d883e760f2.description: Creates a simple image with sound. A cursory investigation will reveal the illusory image.

0eaffdc7-1917-5989-8b8b-9296cdf4819f.name: Sinister Flame
0eaffdc7-1917-5989-8b8b-9296cdf4819f.description: Target's palms are lined with flames (1d4+1 STR loss) for one minute.

f30a2f59-5086-5555-b09d-62da9fd01f31.name: Sinister Polymorph
f30a2f59-5086-5555-b09d-62da9fd01f31.description: WIL save or target is transformed into a harmless animal.

ab47696d-5571-5c01-acb7-390a6150f397.name: Skillfull Repair
ab47696d-5571-5c01-acb7-390a6150f397.description: You make minor repairs to a nonliving object.

c16249b7-7b30-5655-b185-f9472c5c9339.name: Sky Raft
c16249b7-7b30-5655-b185-f9472c5c9339.description: You summon a 3ft wide floating disk that holds up to 100lbs.

5482ba8f-5e77-53e4-b962-03704594f04e.name: Solar Portal
5482ba8f-5e77-53e4-b962-03704594f04e.description: Sends an extraplanar message to all beings that wish to enter your plane. You have no choice which being answers and it holds no loyalty to you or your allies.

aaf5f98f-aad3-5bcc-aa28-feaa87a547b2.name: Song of Repose
aaf5f98f-aad3-5bcc-aa28-feaa87a547b2.description: Target falls into a deep slumber.

eb1f9521-2b17-5dbe-a35e-0166ca7be110.name: Sonic Shattering
eb1f9521-2b17-5dbe-a35e-0166ca7be110.description: A sonic wave causes 1d6 STR loss to susceptible objects or crystalline creatures, ignoring armor.

9a72377b-0541-5f55-8dee-075de8b46724.name: Sorcerer's Lock
9a72377b-0541-5f55-8dee-075de8b46724.description: Any door (magical or otherwise) is held shut until you leave its vicinity.

343ee1d3-eeaf-5ca5-b69f-13868002db54.name: Soul Annex
343ee1d3-eeaf-5ca5-b69f-13868002db54.description: Target's spirit is caged within their body and replaced with the caster's. If the body is slain the original soul departs, but the caster must pass a WIL save to return to their body.

fa77ec44-dee6-5664-a169-96059539a11e.name: Steer's Strength
fa77ec44-dee6-5664-a169-96059539a11e.description: Target's strength triples; unarmed attacks are enhanced.

27b9324a-53ea-5dcf-a875-1e39e713d3e2.name: Strength Tap
27b9324a-53ea-5dcf-a875-1e39e713d3e2.description: A target you touch loses 1d6 STR, which is transferred to you (up to your max STR).

c0cf9cab-2418-528f-b2b1-f2d2ac4fb215.name: Stumbling Steps
c0cf9cab-2418-528f-b2b1-f2d2ac4fb215.description: A target you touch becomes deprived and loses 1 STR.

a9305f6a-38d3-5b87-924f-3257422e3fcf.name: Stupefaction
a9305f6a-38d3-5b87-924f-3257422e3fcf.description: Target temporarily loses sense of place and time. WIL save to overcome.

02e3a8ea-f91a-5724-a790-cf8e0f93aaa6.name: Summon Elemental
02e3a8ea-f91a-5724-a790-cf8e0f93aaa6.description: A being of fire, wire, earth, or wind manifests from available matter to perform a single task for the caster. It follows this command against its will.

69859381-c642-5a37-bbfb-f6dda4ac1226.name: Sway Will
69859381-c642-5a37-bbfb-f6dda4ac1226.description: A target is compelled to follow a stated course of action, without understanding why.

32d23b9a-7425-5620-9583-e4beab4c8e54.name: Temporary Reprieve
32d23b9a-7425-5620-9583-e4beab4c8e54.description: Target regains any lost STR, but loses it again after a few minutes.

4e3b5b1e-0541-5db3-9ecd-76b97dedde4d.name: Terrify
4e3b5b1e-0541-5db3-9ecd-76b97dedde4d.description: Targets within eyesight must pass a WIL save or flee.

724ff32b-724c-52f4-b9c9-19433b315181.name: Terrifying Illusion
724ff32b-724c-52f4-b9c9-19433b315181.description: A target is hunted by a terrible creature only they can see. Its attacks do 1d12 damage; on Critical Damage they must pass a WIL save or become catatonic.

42f44d3d-ddd7-5018-b49f-323e4401b4b9.name: Thief's Bane
42f44d3d-ddd7-5018-b49f-323e4401b4b9.description: An object appears trapped, even to an experienced thief.

2280b45e-5a73-5c59-9aa5-07cd6fc7354c.name: Thwart the Elements
2280b45e-5a73-5c59-9aa5-07cd6fc7354c.description: Damage from energy blasts are impaired against a target for the next hour.

10eeb181-7049-5a25-bb87-b6a237184479.name: Tongue of the Blue Serpent
10eeb181-7049-5a25-bb87-b6a237184479.description: Rust-colored, serpentine letters materialize on a surface you choose. Anyone reading these words becomes immobilized unless they succeed a WIL save.

993e374d-b3ca-5a75-8eb7-d4ac17f57fad.name: Torrential Moat
993e374d-b3ca-5a75-8eb7-d4ac17f57fad.description: You summon a powerful wind that deflects arrows, smaller creatures, and noxious gases.

9062b45a-8894-5d92-a729-19b0964ac8f9.name: Toxic Blast
9062b45a-8894-5d92-a729-19b0964ac8f9.description: A small orb of acid deals 1d6 blast damage to a target.

cf99da19-c4d3-556c-9c4d-a5c5cc0a87bf.name: Transform Aura
cf99da19-c4d3-556c-9c4d-a5c5cc0a87bf.description: Target's aura is made non-magical or vice-versa.

cf2c7a83-6017-5cf2-98f5-eedf64dd1825.name: True Name
cf2c7a83-6017-5cf2-98f5-eedf64dd1825.description: Determines the properties of a magical item you touch.

42b8a7c9-559b-5b1e-ac69-ba6520a45449.name: Trueshift
42b8a7c9-559b-5b1e-ac69-ba6520a45449.description: A willing target takes on a new form (keeping only their WIL), but must pass a WIL save to shift out.

4a2f0791-b428-5a8e-8a67-3f0382490354.name: Twilight Steed
4a2f0791-b428-5a8e-8a67-3f0382490354.description: Summons an arcane steed that never tires, but dissipates within daylight.

78a01d9a-9f8e-540d-bd00-ea9f90be152e.name: Ultimate Sacrifice
78a01d9a-9f8e-540d-bd00-ea9f90be152e.description: The book's holder transfer's their life force into a corpse, reviving both body and soul.

a47d48d9-3c5b-51c9-b570-cfba86d49a03.name: Uncurse
a47d48d9-3c5b-51c9-b570-cfba86d49a03.description: A person or object you touch is freed from a curse or nefarious spell.

c25436a3-79d3-5e78-aeda-008faf43ac4e.name: Undefinable Target
c25436a3-79d3-5e78-aeda-008faf43ac4e.description: An ally becomes immune to mundane ranged attacks for one round.

5e6ccab5-af82-5aee-b858-32ec0083989a.name: Undeniable Courage
5e6ccab5-af82-5aee-b858-32ec0083989a.description: Target passes next WIL save and their attacks are enhanced.

7aeb03cb-4539-5825-becc-374be58ab1b9.name: Unflappable Endurance
7aeb03cb-4539-5825-becc-374be58ab1b9.description: Target does not take Fatigue from non-magical activities or become deprived until their next rest.

1728e8c0-d72d-5db1-93c0-6c069871d9fa.name: Vermin Plague
1728e8c0-d72d-5db1-93c0-6c069871d9fa.description: Summons a swarm of bats, rats, spiders or similar creatures of your choice. They are harmless but distracting and hold no loyalty towards you or your allies.

33177f86-7a70-526c-ba53-49e2be1ed129.name: Vines of Ichor
33177f86-7a70-526c-ba53-49e2be1ed129.description: You spread sticky spiderwebs on the walls, floor and ceilings within a 20ft radius.

cd41c361-869a-5cbb-9de4-b1c237ea87eb.name: Warrior's Edge
cd41c361-869a-5cbb-9de4-b1c237ea87eb.description: Target weapon is enhanced, and victim automatically fails a critical damage save.

f24b2730-f3f2-5a5d-8299-14fbfc7b2d76.name: Windborn
f24b2730-f3f2-5a5d-8299-14fbfc7b2d76.description: You direct a powerful wind in a straight line, strong enough to blow over small boulders.

e87ffa45-264a-5896-a551-7cedcd085ce6.name: Winter's Woe
e87ffa45-264a-5896-a551-7cedcd085ce6.description: An icy storm assails multiple targets, obscuring visibility and making the ground icy and treacherous.

ad90b73d-cd45-5c69-bb80-40e9eaaacb23.name: Witch Sight
ad90b73d-cd45-5c69-bb80-40e9eaaacb23.description: Magical auras become visible to you for one hour.

dcc43074-0246-5de8-9284-5f059c7faee8.name: Wizard's Exit
dcc43074-0246-5de8-9284-5f059c7faee8.description: You and and anyone you touch can flee to safety at double speed.

75f91992-c23e-5d86-8d91-3c6c50380d75.name: Wizard's Grasp
75f91992-c23e-5d86-8d91-3c6c50380d75.description: You control a phantasmal hand that can lift up to 5 pounds.

e0266df1-9f83-53e6-b4ee-7b9e286da804.name: Wizard's Haven
e0266df1-9f83-53e6-b4ee-7b9e286da804.description: A small, walled-in area cannot be scryed.

a351507e-41e3-5eda-9fc0-2861501b6756.name: Wizardsniff
a351507e-41e3-5eda-9fc0-2861501b6756.description: You can feel any magic within a 60ft radius.

b9890643-bd8a-5847-8698-156306babd03.name: Word of Pain
b9890643-bd8a-5847-8698-156306babd03.description: A single phrase from your lips does 1d12 blast damage. Affected targets are also deafened.
